note: The one table of Japanese labels. Every enum word keeps its English value beside the label. tone: ok (verified good), warn, bad, unknown (unknown, unmeasured, stale, not collected), info (a fact, neither good nor bad). An unknown word is shown as 未定義の語 with tone unknown. keys: the Japanese name of each field a card shows as a table (every field name has one; tested). texts: fixed English sentences and their Japanese rendering; the page shows the Japanese with the original in small type, and a sentence not in this table as the original, labelled so.

texts.The recorded ceiling is not a grant or a: 記録された上限は許可でも承認でもありません。provider admission は閉じたままです。

texts.No AI answer is available for this reque: この要求には AI の回答がないため、決定論的な経路へ引き渡しました。この通知と添付されるプレイブック参照は固定または検証済みの資料であり、AI の回答ではありません。判断と実施の権限は Edge の決定論的な制御面にあります。
